audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Arctic Assault her E in eight places ('her E Arctic Assault', 'her E charge'). Arctic Assault is her Q (650 range, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s). Permafrost is the E (560 range, 1.5s) and only stuns a target already at maximum Frost stacks.
audit.why: Riot text: Q 'Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air'; E 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks'. Frost is applied by W Winter's Wrath. A player told to dodge 'her E' watches the wrong slot and eats the knockup.
audit.corrected: All slot letters fixed; the Frost-stack precondition on Permafrost stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said that Sejuani's own CC feeds Lightslinger.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage'. Her Arctic Assault knockup, Permafrost stun and Glacial Prison stun each arm two empowered autos for Lucian. The mirror recorded this from her side; it belongs on this page too.

edits.before: Sejuani is an immobile tank with no early gap-closer until her E charge, so levels 1-3 are pure abuse for me. I cast Piercing Light, then fire the Lightslinger double-tap into her before she has the stats or Permafrost stacks to answer — my level 2 trade alone chunks a tank who can only walk up and take it. The one thing to respect is her E Arctic Assault: if she charges in and lands the Permafrost stun on a fresh Frost stack she can flip a trade, so I hold Relentless Pursuit to dash out of the charge rather than burning it to chase. Trade at Q range, weave Ardent Blaze for the speed, and never sit still long enough for her to build a stun.
edits.after: Sejuani is an immobile tank with no gap-closer until Arctic Assault (Q) at level 2, so levels 1-3 are pure abuse for you. Cast Piercing Light, then fire the Lightslinger double-tap before she has the stats or Frost stacks to answer — the level 2 trade alone chunks a tank who can only walk up and take it. The one thing to respect is Arctic Assault: 650 range, 18s at rank 1, and if it lands she can stack Frost with Winter's Wrath and detonate Permafrost. Hold Relentless Pursuit to dash out of the charge, never to chase. Trade at Q range and never sit still while Frost is stacking.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay mine — my Q poke and the Lightslinger bursts keep chipping her down faster than her tanky base stats sustain, and every time she steps up for a Permafrost stack I dash out with E and reset my passive. At 6 her R Glacial Prison adds a real all-in threat, but it's a teamfight tool more than a lane-flip; in a straight 1v1 I still kite her ult and the E charge with Ardent Blaze move-speed. The danger is the gank setup — her E-into-stun is jungler bait, so I respect her wave position and don't overextend past river when her jungle is unknown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 level off — your Q poke still chips faster than her base stats sustain, and every Winter's Wrath step-up is a cue to dash out on E and reset the passive. At 6 the lane changes hands: Glacial Prison stuns, then Permafrost stuns again the moment Frost is full, and two chained stuns on a 1400-range marksman with no escape left is a death, not a trade. Her Q-into-stun is also jungler bait, so hold wave position short and never step past river with Relentless Pursuit down.

notes: Mirror (audits/top/sejuani__lucian.json) was already audited; chart restated from Lucian's side rather than re-derived. The two win-rate sources disagree: my packet says 62.5% over 8 games, the mirror uses 57.41% for Sejuani over 270 games (matching this brief's top-level games:270). I followed the 270-game figure. tone is '#3ddc97' (the green used for favoured lanes) while diff is HARD — the colour looks wrong for this matchup but I do not have the palette mapping, so I left it alone rather than guess. Ratings on the two sides use inconsistent scales in the existing data (the mirror gives Sejuani 5/10 and 4/10 on stages she wins); I kept this page's convention of higher = better for Lucian.
